observation.command:
CID=$(docker exec strassennamen-keycloak /opt/keycloak/bin/kcadm.sh get clients -r my-realm -q clientId=strassennamen --fields id --format csv --noquotes 2>/dev/null | tail -1)
echo "CID=$CID"
docker exec strassennamen-keycloak /opt/keycloak/bin/kcadm.sh create clients/$CID/roles -r my-realm -s name=app-access 2>&1 | tail -1
docker exec strassennamen-keycloak /opt/keycloak/bin/kcadm.sh create clients/$CID/roles -r my-realm -s name=editor 2>&1 | tail -1
docker exec strassennamen-keycloak /opt/keycloak/bin/kcadm.sh add-roles -r my-realm --uusername testuser --cclientid strassennamen --rolename app-access --rolename editor 2>&1 | tail -1; echo "ADD:$?"
